correctness.rationale: For LCD planes with an associated neighbor, the common line has odd self-dot: even line forces both nonshared generators to pair 1 with it, contradicting orthogonality requirement. For odd u, every containing LCD plane has unique orthogonal basis {u,v} with Q(v)=1, v∈u-perp, and associated adjacency reduces to v·w=1. With t all-ones, f=t+u controls the parity character on u-perp, yielding h(h-1)/4 pairs for even n or h(h-2)/4 for odd n except forbidden u=t. Summing over 2^{n-1} odd lines gives the stated e_n for every n≥2; n=2 and 3 give zero. Independent exhaustive labeled-2-plane computations through n=7 matched 0,0,24,180,1920,15120; these corroborate, not replace, the argument.
